text:
sam_fin: Invoice INV-2026-0432 for TriadMetrics (Acct: TM-9183) is past due — $12,450. Sent 2026-02-28. CC on file declined today. see: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0432.pdf

maria_cs: cc decline? did we get AVS/decline code?

sam_fin: Decline: `card_declined` / `do_not_honor`. Bank returned no further details. customer replied to billing email: 'Sorry, card expired, will update by EOD.'

jordan_sales: They're on SMB plan and using hosted API. Usage spiked last month. Is there a suspensions window? we may lose them if we cut.

sam_fin: Standard dunning step 2 sent today. I can offer 3-installment plan over 90 days to avoid suspension. Need approval to push hold to 30->60->suspend schedule.

lara_ops: If we offer installment, we need signed payment plan doc + card on file. We can set up autopay in Stripe with `setup_intent` link.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: I'll reach out to the customer now with the 3x plan and require card update. copying the email draft below.

maria_cs (email draft): Hi Alex — we saw your CC failed. We can set up a 3-payment plan: $4,150 x3 monthly. To proceed we'll send a secure link to update your card and a short agreement. Please confirm by EOD 3/15. If we don't hear back we'll move to temporary service reduction on 3/22. — Maria, CS

sam_fin: Also note contract has `net30` and auto-renew. We can approve plan for up to 90 days w/o exec sign for < $15k.

jordan_sales: I'll call Alex after email. If they commit, let's keep service. If they ghost, escalate to collections/legal.

billing-bot: Payment plan template created: `PP-2026-057` — link: https://redwood.ai/docs/finance/payment-plans/PP-2026-057

maria_cs: :eyes: call scheduled for 11:30 PST.

sam_fin: Update: Alex called — says CFO out until Friday but can pay half today via ACH. Wants email confirmation now. Maria, can you accept ACH and apply partial credit?

lara_ops: Yes, we accept ACH. Sam, I'll create manual invoice adjustment for partial payment and set invoice status to `part-paid`. Provide ACH instructions and reference `INV-2026-0432`.

maria_cs: Sent ACH instructions and payment plan doc. Customer replied 'we'll send $6,225 via ACH by EOD and set up card for rest'.

sam_fin: Good. Marking thread resolved for now. Please update invoice when ACH clears. If no clearance by 3/18 escalate to Jordan for final warning.

jordan_sales: Copy. Will follow up 3/18. thanks.

sam_fin: Closing note: leaving note on account: '3-part plan agreed; ACH partial pending; card update expected; 3/22 service reduction window.'
